hints.title: Element Contribution Counting
hints.text: Instead of finding each odd subarray, count how many odd-length subarrays contain element arr[i].

hints.title: Total Subarrays Containing Index i
hints.text: Index i can be chosen in (i + 1) ways as starting point and (n - i) ways as ending point, giving (i + 1) * (n - i) total subarrays.

hints.title: Odd Subarray Count Formula
hints.text: Exactly ((i + 1) * (n - i) + 1) // 2 of those subarrays have odd length. Multiply this count by arr[i] and sum over all elements.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def sumOddLengthSubarrays(self, arr: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(arr)
        ans = 0
        for i, x in enumerate(arr):
            total_subarrays = (i + 1) * (n - i)
            odd_subarrays = (total_subarrays + 1) // 2
            ans += x * odd_subarrays
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all odd subarrays takes O(N^2) or O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Element-frequency combinatorics operates in a single linear pass with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies combinatorial contribution technique to compute sums in O(N).
complexity.notes: Optimal O(N) time and O(1) space.
